name: Astone et al. 2018 CCSN CNN
source: Paper Sec. on the Convolutional Neural Network and Fig. 4 (block diagram): six repeats of zero padding, 3x3 convolution with 8 filters and ReLU, max pooling and dropout, then Flatten and a 2-neuron softmax layer. Input from Figs. 2 and 3 (RGB image from cWB spectrograms of H1, L1 and V1).
unknowns: The dropout rate is not stated ('soft dropout' at the end of every block).
The pooling window is 2x2 only by the paper's 'minimum possible contraction'; stride is not stated.
Zero padding before each convolution has no glyph in the fixed symbol set and is not drawn.
Whether the final layer is a dense layer of two neurons applied directly after Flatten is stated in words only.
notes: The input is a 64x256 colour image (red Hanford, green Livingston, blue Virgo) of whitened wavelet spectrograms. 2D layers are drawn with 1D glyphs; kernel shapes are in the size cells.
